account_tokens_target_email_check.name: account_tokens_target_email_check
account_tokens_target_email_check.value: ("account_tokens"."purpose" = 'password_reset' and "account_tokens"."target_email" is null) or ("account_tokens"."purpose" in ('email_verification', 'email_change') and "account_tokens"."target_email" = lower(btrim("account_tokens"."target_email")) and "account_tokens"."target_email" ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+\.[^[:space:]@]+$')

admin_users_name_check.name: admin_users_name_check
admin_users_name_check.value: "admin_users"."name" is null or char_length(btrim("admin_users"."name")) between 1 and 120

admin_users_activation_check.name: admin_users_activation_check
admin_users_activation_check.value: ("admin_users"."status" = 'invited' and "admin_users"."password_hash" is null) or ("admin_users"."status" <> 'invited' and "admin_users"."password_hash" is not null and "admin_users"."name" is not null and "admin_users"."email_verified_at" is not null)

applications_snapshot_check.name: applications_snapshot_check
applications_snapshot_check.value: ("applications"."creator_profile_snapshot" is null and "applications"."snapshot_captured_at" is null) or ("applications"."creator_profile_snapshot" is not null and jsonb_typeof("applications"."creator_profile_snapshot") = 'object' and "applications"."snapshot_captured_at" is not null)

campaigns_submission_pair_check.name: campaigns_submission_pair_check
campaigns_submission_pair_check.value: ("campaigns"."submission_id" is null and "campaigns"."submission_fingerprint" is null) or ("campaigns"."submission_id" is not null and "campaigns"."submission_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

campaigns_category_check.name: campaigns_category_check
campaigns_category_check.value: "campaigns"."category" is null or "campaigns"."category" in ('Food & Cafe', 'Fashion & Lifestyle', 'Memes & Comedy', 'Education & Motivation', 'Tech & Apps', 'Travel & Local', 'Fitness & Health', 'Beauty & Skincare', 'Finance & Business', 'Music & Entertainment', 'Punjabi Culture', 'Other')

campaigns_expiry_check.name: campaigns_expiry_check
campaigns_expiry_check.value: "campaigns"."expires_at" > "campaigns"."created_at" and ("campaigns"."deadline_at" is null or "campaigns"."deadline_at" = "campaigns"."expires_at") and ("campaigns"."expired_at" is null or "campaigns"."expired_at" >= "campaigns"."expires_at")

creators_category_check.name: creators_category_check
creators_category_check.value: "creators"."category" is null or "creators"."category" in ('Food & Cafe', 'Fashion & Lifestyle', 'Memes & Comedy', 'Education & Motivation', 'Tech & Apps', 'Travel & Local', 'Fitness & Health', 'Beauty & Skincare', 'Finance & Business', 'Music & Entertainment', 'Punjabi Culture', 'Other')

creators_content_types_check.name: creators_content_types_check
creators_content_types_check.value: "creators"."content_types" ~ '^(Story|Reel|Post|UGC Video|YouTube Shorts|YouTube Video)(, (Story|Reel|Post|UGC Video|YouTube Shorts|YouTube Video))*$'
